title: Communications Officer
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Bristol based business

Your new role

Are you a creative communicator with a passion for storytelling, digital content and audience engagement?We're looking for a Communications Officer to join a well-respected national organisation. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape public engagement, create compelling content and support communications campaigns that connect with diverse audiences.

The Role

As Communications Officer, you'll play a key role in delivering engaging communications across multiple channels. Working closely with operational teams and stakeholders, you'll create content that promotes projects, events, community engagement initiatives and organisational priorities.You'll be responsible for:
- Creating compelling content for digital, print and social media channels
- Developing and delivering communications campaigns to support strategic objectives
- Writing press releases, news stories, blogs and stakeholder communications
- Managing and growing social media presence and audience engagement
- Supporting media relations and responding to communications enquiries
- Producing high-quality photography, video and multimedia content where required
- Monitoring campaign performance and providing insights and recommendations
- Building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners
- Ensuring brand consistency across all communications activity

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in communications, PR, marketing or public affairs
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong content creation and storytelling abilities
- Experience managing social media platforms and digital campaigns
- Confidence working with a range of stakeholders and external partners
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects
- Experience using analytics and reporting tools to measure engagement
- A proactive, creative and collaborative approach

What you'll get in return
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Competitive pension scheme
- Ongoing professional development opportunities
- The chance to work for a purpose-driven organisation making a positive impact on communities and the environment
- A supportive and collaborative team culture

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

North Bristol £33,000-£36,000 per annum Office-based, 5 days per week

We're looking for a hungry, proactive and commercially minded Digital Marketing Executive to join an established and successful independent business in Bristol.

The role is ultimately about driving more visitors, increasing sales and helping the business grow through effective, engaging marketing. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad mix of digital and traditional activity and see the direct impact of your work.

This is a hands-on role covering digital marketing, social media, content, e-commerce, SEO, email marketing, campaigns and analytics.

The Person we're looking for

You won't necessarily have experience across every area of digital marketing, and that's absolutely fine. We're more interested in your attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

You'll be someone who is happy to research, teach yourself new skills and find solutions when you come across something you haven't done before. You'll have a solid grounding in marketing and digital, but we're open to someone whose experience is stronger in some areas than others and who is keen to develop.

We're looking for someone who is resourceful, self-motivated and confident working autonomously, who takes ownership, gets things done and understands that great marketing should deliver commercial results.

If you're excited by the opportunity to broaden your skills, contribute ideas and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing and developing website and e-commerce content
- Creating engaging social media and digital content
- Supporting SEO and paid digital activity
- Planning and delivering email marketing campaigns
- Supporting seasonal campaigns, promotions and events
- Using analytics and reporting to understand performance
- Helping to improve the customer journey and online experience
- Supporting traditional marketing activity including print, advertising and promotional materials
- Working with colleagues and external suppliers to deliver marketing activity

What We're Looking For

You'll ideally have experience or knowledge in some of the following:
- Digital marketing and social media
- Content creation
- SEO and website management
- E-commerce
- Email marketing
- Google Analytics and Google Search Console
- Google Ads
- Canva

You do not need to have experience in all of these areas. A strong marketing foundation, digital confidence and a willingness to learn are more important.

What's On Offer
- £33,000-£36,000 per annum, depending on experience
- A varied role with genuine ownership
- The opportunity to broaden and develop your digital marketing skills
- A supportive and collaborative working environment
- Generous holiday allowance
- A range of company benefits

If you're a self-motivated marketer who is curious, capable and keen to keep learning, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media and Content Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Social Media & Content Executive

Bristol

£30k-£35k

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media & Content Executive to join a family-owned property business in Bristol.

This is a varied role where you'll take ownership of the company's social media and content, while supporting wider marketing activity designed to drive enquiries, strengthen the brand and raise the company's profile within the property market.

This is a standalone marketing role, so we're looking for someone who is confident working independently and taking ownership. You'll need to be self-sufficient, proactive and full of ideas, able to spot opportunities, decide what needs doing and get on with it rather than waiting for direction. We're looking for someone who will bring energy and creativity to the role, constantly looking for what could be done next, how things can be improved and new ways to engage and grow the audience

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
- Creating engaging photo, video and written content
- Managing property listings across relevant property platforms
- Creating property descriptions, campaigns, blogs and promotional content
- Supporting lead generation and improving enquiry conversion
- Working with external SEO, content and paid advertising specialists
- Monitoring marketing performance, analytics and ROI
- Creating testimonials, case studies and other brand content
- Building relationships with relevant partners and local organisations
- Keeping an eye on competitor activity, pricing and market trends

About You

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience in social media, content or digital marketing who is confident at taking ownership and getting things done.

You'll need:
- Strong social media, copywriting and content creation skills
- Good photography and videography skills
- A creative eye and confidence creating content for different platforms
- A commercial mindset and understanding of lead generation
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently
- Basic Canva or Adobe skills

Experience in property, student marketing or another consumer-facing sector would be useful but not essential.

Knowledge of the Bristol market and local scene, including universities, communities and local businesses, would also be an advantage.

The Person

You'll be proactive, creative and commercially minded, with plenty of initiative and a genuine interest in creating great content.

This is a small, close-knit business, so we're looking for someone who is hands-on, personable and happy to get stuck in.

The role is predominantly office-based in Bristol, ideally five days a week, with the possibility of one day working from home.

Bristol £30k-£35k Full-time

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
